    #[test]
    fn log_service_answers_a_question_with_its_state() {
        let (_dir, service) = log_service();
        let message = BackboneMessage::new(
            BackboneMessageKind::Request,
            HubId::DEVICE,
            Some(HubId::LOG),
        );
        let invocation = ServiceInvocation::new(&message);
        // A question is answered with the inspection of the log state (the
        // synchronous Response path).
        assert_eq!(
            service.invoke(&invocation).unwrap(),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("log: 0 entries".to_owned())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn log_service_rejects_non_log_requests() {
        let service = LogService::new();
        for kind in [
            BackboneMessageKind::Response,
            BackboneMessageKind::Event,
            BackboneMessageKind::Broadcast,
            BackboneMessageKind::LifecycleSignal,
        ] {
            let message = BackboneMessage::new(kind, HubId::DEVICE, Some(HubId::LOG));
            let invocation = ServiceInvocation::new(&message);
            assert_eq!(
                service.invoke(&invocation).unwrap(),
                ServiceResult::Rejected,
                "{kind} is not a log request"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn service_results_are_distinct() {
        assert_ne!(ServiceResult::Accepted, ServiceResult::Completed);
        assert_ne!(ServiceResult::Completed, ServiceResult::Rejected);
        assert_ne!(ServiceResult::Accepted, ServiceResult::Rejected);
        assert_ne!(
            ServiceResult::Inspected("a".to_owned()),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("b".to_owned())
        );
        assert_ne!(
            ServiceResult::Inspected("a".to_owned()),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn workspace_duplicate_open_is_rejected() {
        let (_dir, workspace) = workspace_service();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        // Phase 7H: opening an already-open workspace is rejected by the
        // validated lifecycle — deterministically, never a panic.
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Open("other".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
    }

    fn workspace_close_without_open_is_rejected() {

        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Close,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
    }

    }

    /// A workspace service over an isolated storage root.
    fn workspace_service() -> (crate::test_support::TempDir, WorkspaceService) {
        let dir = crate::test_support::TempDir::new("7h1-workspace");
        let service = WorkspaceService::with_root(dir.path().join("store"));
        (dir, service)
    }

    /// A project service over an isolated storage root.
    fn project_service() -> (crate::test_support::TempDir, ProjectService) {
        let dir = crate::test_support::TempDir::new("7h1-project");
        let service = ProjectService::with_root(dir.path().join("store"));
        (dir, service)
    }

    fn package_service() -> (crate::test_support::TempDir, PackageService) {
        let dir = crate::test_support::TempDir::new("7h1-package");
        let service = PackageService::with_root(dir.path().join("store"));
        (dir, service)
    }

    /// A workspace service over the same storage root as `dir` — the reopen
    /// path: a fresh service reads the persisted state a previous service
    /// wrote.
    fn workspace_service_in(dir: &crate::test_support::TempDir) -> WorkspaceService {
        WorkspaceService::with_root(dir.path().join("store"))
    }

    /// A project service over the same storage root as `dir`.
    fn project_service_in(dir: &crate::test_support::TempDir) -> ProjectService {
        ProjectService::with_root(dir.path().join("store"))
    }

    /// A package service over the same storage root as `dir`.
    fn package_service_in(dir: &crate::test_support::TempDir) -> PackageService {
        PackageService::with_root(dir.path().join("store"))
    }

    }

    /// A log service over the same storage root as `dir` (restart path).
    fn log_service_in(dir: &crate::test_support::TempDir) -> LogService {
        LogService::with_root(dir.path().join("store"))
    }

    /// The full path of a persisted entry under the service's storage root.
    fn stored_entry(
        dir: &std::path::Path,
        category: StorageCategory,
        name: &str,
    ) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        dir.join("store").join(category.dir_name()).join(name)
    }

    /// Decodes the persisted state text of an entry through the existing
    /// `.ra` text codec.
    fn persisted_state(dir: &std::path::Path, category: StorageCategory, name: &str) -> String {
        let bytes = std::fs::read(stored_entry(dir, category, name)).unwrap();
        Pss::new()
            .deserialize_program(ra_persistence::Format::Ra, &bytes)
            .unwrap()
            .text()
            .to_owned()
    }

    #[test]
    fn workspace_open_persists_its_state() {
        let (dir, workspace) = workspace_service();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        // The workspace state is persisted atomically into `workspaces/`
        // through the existing `.ra` text codec.
        assert_eq!(
            persisted_state(dir.path(), StorageCategory::Workspace, "ra-main"),
            "workspace: ra-main"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn workspace_close_preserves_persisted_state_and_reopen_restores_it() {
        let (dir, workspace) = workspace_service();
        invoke(
            &workspace,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
            HubId::WORKSPACE,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Close,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        // Closing does not delete the persisted state.
        assert!(stored_entry(dir.path(), StorageCategory::Workspace, "ra-main").is_file());
        // A fresh service over the same root reopens the workspace.
        let reopened = workspace_service_in(&dir);
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &reopened,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &reopened,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("workspace: ra-main".to_owned())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn workspace_reopen_restores_the_identity() {
        let (dir, workspace) = workspace_service();
        invoke(
            &workspace,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
            HubId::WORKSPACE,
        );
        let reopened = workspace_service_in(&dir);
        invoke(
            &reopened,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
            HubId::WORKSPACE,
        );
        let state = reopened.state.borrow();
        let opened = state.workspace.as_ref().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(opened.id().name(), "ra-main");
        assert_eq!(opened.id().kind(), ActiveObjectKind::Workspace);
    }

    #[test]
    fn workspace_missing_persisted_state_opens_fresh() {
        let (dir, workspace) = workspace_service();
        // No persisted entry exists: the workspace opens fresh and the open
        // persists it.
        assert!(!stored_entry(dir.path(), StorageCategory::Workspace, "ra-main").exists());
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        assert!(stored_entry(dir.path(), StorageCategory::Workspace, "ra-main").is_file());
    }

    #[test]
    fn workspace_open_rejects_corrupt_persisted_state() {
        let (dir, workspace) = workspace_service();
        // A persisted entry that cannot be decoded through the codec is
        // rejected deterministically.
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir.path().join("store/workspaces")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(
            stored_entry(dir.path(), StorageCategory::Workspace, "ra-main"),
            b"\xff\xfe not utf-8",
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
        // A persisted entry of the wrong kind (or a mismatched name) is also
        // rejected.
        let (dir2, workspace2) = workspace_service();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir2.path().join("store/workspaces")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(
            stored_entry(dir2.path(), StorageCategory::Workspace, "ra-main"),
            b"project: ra-main",
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace2,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
    }

                    name: "ra-lib".to_owned(),
                    parent: "other".to_owned(),

                HubId::PROJECT
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );

    #[test]
    fn interrupted_persisted_writes_are_recovered() {
        // An interrupted atomic write leaves a `*.ra-tmp` sibling; the
        // existing Recovery service resolves it (rolls it forward when no
        // final file exists, removes it as stale otherwise).
        let dir = crate::test_support::TempDir::new("7h1-recovery");
        let store = dir.path().join("store");
        // Workspace: an interrupted write is rolled forward.
        std::fs::create_dir_all(store.join("workspaces")).unwrap();
        let pss = Pss::new();
        let bytes = pss
            .serialize_program(
                ra_persistence::Format::Ra,
                &ra_persistence::LiveProgram::new("ra-main", "workspace: ra-main"),
            )
            .unwrap();
        std::fs::write(store.join("workspaces/ra-main.ra-tmp"), &bytes).unwrap();
        // Project: same, with an association.
        std::fs::create_dir_all(store.join("projects")).unwrap();
        let bytes = pss
            .serialize_program(
                ra_persistence::Format::Ra,
                &ra_persistence::LiveProgram::new("ra-lib", "project: ra-lib\nin: ra-main"),
            )
            .unwrap();
        std::fs::write(store.join("projects/ra-lib.ra-tmp"), &bytes).unwrap();
        // Package: same.
        std::fs::create_dir_all(store.join("packages")).unwrap();
        let bytes = pss
            .serialize_program(
                ra_persistence::Format::Ra,
                &ra_persistence::LiveProgram::new("ra-pkg", "package: ra-pkg\nin: ra-lib"),
            )
            .unwrap();
        std::fs::write(store.join("packages/ra-pkg.ra-tmp"), &bytes).unwrap();
        // The existing recovery mechanism resolves every interrupted write.
        let report = Recovery::new().recover(&store).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(report.scanned, 3);
        assert_eq!(report.restored.len(), 3);
        assert!(report.failed.is_empty());
        // The recovered state is reopenable through the normal open path.
        let workspace = workspace_service_in(&dir);
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &workspace,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        let project = project_service_in(&dir);
        invoke(
            &project,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Open("ra-lib".to_owned()),
            HubId::PROJECT,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &project,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::PROJECT
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("project: ra-lib in ra-main".to_owned())
        );
        let package = package_service_in(&dir);
        invoke(
            &package,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Open("ra-pkg".to_owned()),
            HubId::PACKAGE,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &package,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::PACKAGE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("package: ra-pkg in ra-lib".to_owned())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn stale_temp_with_existing_final_is_removed_by_recovery() {
        let dir = crate::test_support::TempDir::new("7h1-recovery-stale");
        let store = dir.path().join("store");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(store.join("workspaces")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(store.join("workspaces/ra-main"), b"committed").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(store.join("workspaces/ra-main.ra-tmp"), b"older attempt").unwrap();
        let report = Recovery::new().recover(&store).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(report.scanned, 1);
        assert_eq!(report.removed.len(), 1);
        assert!(report.restored.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(
            std::fs::read(store.join("workspaces/ra-main")).unwrap(),
            b"committed"
        );
        assert!(!store.join("workspaces/ra-main.ra-tmp").exists());
    }

    #[test]
    fn active_object_persistence_stays_inside_the_storage_root() {
        // Opening and persisting workspace/project/package objects writes
        // only into their own categories under the storage root — no
        // arbitrary filesystem access outside Syss.
        let (dir, workspace) = workspace_service();
        let project = project_service_in(&dir);
        let package = package_service_in(&dir);
        invoke(
            &workspace,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Open("ra-main".to_owned()),
            HubId::WORKSPACE,
        );
        invoke(
            &project,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::OpenIn {
                name: "ra-lib".to_owned(),
                parent: "ra-main".to_owned(),
            },
            HubId::PROJECT,
        );
        invoke(
            &package,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::OpenIn {
                name: "ra-pkg".to_owned(),
                parent: "ra-lib".to_owned(),
            },
            HubId::PACKAGE,
        );
        // The persisted entries live only under their categories.
        assert!(stored_entry(dir.path(), StorageCategory::Workspace, "ra-main").is_file());
        assert!(stored_entry(dir.path(), StorageCategory::Project, "ra-lib").is_file());
        assert!(stored_entry(dir.path(), StorageCategory::Package, "ra-pkg").is_file());
        // No other category was written by the active-object domains.
        for category in StorageCategory::ALL {
            let dir_path = dir.path().join("store").join(category.dir_name());
            if matches!(
                category,
                StorageCategory::Workspace | StorageCategory::Project | StorageCategory::Package
            ) {
                assert!(dir_path.is_dir(), "{category} dir missing");
            } else {
                assert!(
                    !dir_path.exists(),
                    "{category} dir was created unexpectedly"
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // ── Phase 7H.2: settings / history / log persistence ─────

    /// The path of a persisted platform-state file under the service root.
    fn stored_platform_state(
        dir: &std::path::Path,
        category: StorageCategory,
        name: &str,
    ) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        dir.join("store").join(category.dir_name()).join(name)
    }

    #[test]
    fn settings_have_deterministic_defaults() {
        let (_dir, settings) = settings_service();

        assert_eq!(

                ServiceOperation::Get("theme".to_owned()),

            ),

                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Get("view".to_owned()),
                HubId::SETTINGS
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("editor".to_owned())
        );
        // An unknown setting has no value.
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &settings,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Get("nope".to_owned()),
                HubId::SETTINGS
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn settings_update_persists_and_retrieves() {

        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &settings,

                ServiceOperation::Set {
                    key: "theme".to_owned(),
                    value: "dark".to_owned(),
                },
                HubId::SETTINGS
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );

        assert_eq!(
            invoke(

    }

    #[test]
    fn settings_reject_invalid_updates() {
        let (_dir, settings) = settings_service();
        // Unsupported values for a fixed-set setting are rejected.
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &settings,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Set {
                    key: "theme".to_owned(),
                    value: "blue".to_owned(),
                },
                HubId::SETTINGS
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
        // Invalid keys and values are rejected deterministically.
        for bad in ["", ".", "a/b"] {
            assert_eq!(
                invoke(
                    &settings,
                    BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                    ServiceOperation::Set {
                        key: bad.to_owned(),
                        value: "x".to_owned(),
                    },
                    HubId::SETTINGS
                ),
                ServiceResult::Rejected,
                "key {bad:?} accepted"
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &settings,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Set {
                    key: "autosave".to_owned(),
                    value: "".to_owned(),
                },
                HubId::SETTINGS
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &settings,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Set {
                    key: "autosave".to_owned(),
                    value: "a\nb".to_owned(),
                },
                HubId::SETTINGS
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
        // No invalid value was persisted.
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &settings,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::SETTINGS
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("settings: (empty)".to_owned())
        );
    }

        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn history_records_in_order_and_persists() {
        let (dir, history) = history_service();
        invoke(
            &history,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Record("open workspace ra-main".to_owned()),
            HubId::HISTORY,
        );
        invoke(
            &history,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Record("save document".to_owned()),
            HubId::HISTORY,
        );
        // Ordering is the record order, and the state is persisted.
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &history,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::HISTORY
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected(
                "history: 2 entries [open workspace ra-main, save document]".to_owned()
            )
        );
        assert!(stored_platform_state(dir.path(), StorageCategory::History, "history").is_file());
    }

    #[test]
    fn history_restores_its_entries_after_restart() {
        let (dir, history) = history_service();
        invoke(
            &history,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Record("open workspace ra-main".to_owned()),
            HubId::HISTORY,
        );
        invoke(
            &history,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Record("save document".to_owned()),
            HubId::HISTORY,
        );
        let restored = history_service_in(&dir);
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &restored,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::HISTORY
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected(
                "history: 2 entries [open workspace ra-main, save document]".to_owned()
            )
        );
        // Appending after restore keeps the order.
        invoke(
            &restored,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Record("close document".to_owned()),
            HubId::HISTORY,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &restored,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::HISTORY
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected(
                "history: 3 entries [open workspace ra-main, save document, close document]"
                    .to_owned()
            )
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn log_records_structured_entries() {
        let (_dir, log) = log_service();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &log,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::RecordLog {
                    severity: LogSeverity::Warning,
                    source: "workspace".to_owned(),
                    message: "disk nearly full".to_owned(),
                },
                HubId::LOG
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        // The record carries its deterministic sequence, severity, source and
        // message; the summary lists the messages (back-compatible).
        let state = log.state.borrow();
        let record = &state.records[0];
        assert_eq!(record.sequence(), 1);
        assert_eq!(record.severity(), LogSeverity::Warning);
        assert_eq!(record.source(), "workspace");
        assert_eq!(record.message(), "disk nearly full");
        drop(state);
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &log,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::LOG
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("log: 1 entries [disk nearly full]".to_owned())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn log_record_messages_are_backward_compatible() {
        let (_dir, log) = log_service();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &log,
                BackboneMessageKind::Command,
                ServiceOperation::Record("platform ready".to_owned()),
                HubId::LOG
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &log,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::LOG
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("log: 1 entries [platform ready]".to_owned())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn log_persists_and_restores_structured_records_after_restart() {
        let (dir, log) = log_service();
        invoke(
            &log,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::RecordLog {
                severity: LogSeverity::Error,
                source: "storage".to_owned(),
                message: "write failed".to_owned(),
            },
            HubId::LOG,
        );
        invoke(
            &log,
            BackboneMessageKind::Command,
            ServiceOperation::Record("platform ready".to_owned()),
            HubId::LOG,
        );
        // A fresh service over the same root restores the structured records
        // with their severity, source and deterministic order. Loading is
        // lazy, so the first operation triggers the load.
        let restored = log_service_in(&dir);
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &restored,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::LOG
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("log: 2 entries [write failed, platform ready]".to_owned())
        );
        {
            let state = restored.state.borrow();
            assert_eq!(state.records.len(), 2);
            assert_eq!(state.records[0].severity(), LogSeverity::Error);
            assert_eq!(state.records[0].source(), "storage");
            assert_eq!(state.records[0].message(), "write failed");
            assert_eq!(state.records[1].severity(), LogSeverity::Info);
            assert_eq!(state.records[1].source(), "log");
            assert_eq!(state.records[1].message(), "platform ready");
        }
    }

    #[test]

            invoke(

                    severity: LogSeverity::Info,
                    source: "workspace".to_owned(),
                    message: "a\nb".to_owned(),

            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
        assert_eq!(

        );
    }

        let (dir2, log2) = log_service();

        std::fs::write(
            stored_platform_state(dir2.path(), StorageCategory::Logs, "log"),

        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &log2,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::Inspect,
                HubId::LOG
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
    }

    // ── Phase 7H: document operations ─────────────────────────

    /// A document service over an isolated storage root: `store` under the
    /// temp dir holds the platform storage, `device` holds the device files
    /// the operations read from and write to.
    fn document_service() -> (crate::test_support::TempDir, WorkspaceService) {
        let dir = crate::test_support::TempDir::new("7h-document");
        let service = WorkspaceService::with_root(dir.path().join("store"));
        (dir, service)
    }

    /// Writes a device file under the `device` directory and returns its
    /// path.
    fn write_device_file(dir: &std::path::Path, name: &str, content: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        let device = dir.join("device");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&device).unwrap();
        let path = device.join(name);
        std::fs::write(&path, content).unwrap();
        path
    }

    /// The stored file of a document in the platform's files category.
    fn stored_document(dir: &std::path::Path, name: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        dir.join("store").join("files").join(name)
    }

    #[test]
    fn document_open_loads_a_device_file_as_the_active_document() {
        let (dir, service) = document_service();
        let source = write_device_file(dir.path(), "main.ra", "let x = 1;");
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::OpenDocument { source },
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Opened("opened main.ra".to_owned())
        );
        // The document is the active document and reads its current state.
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::InspectDocument,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("document: main.ra: let x = 1;".to_owned())
        );
        // The device file was brought into the platform's files category
        // through the existing stack (Device File → SySS).
        assert_eq!(
            std::fs::read(stored_document(dir.path(), "main.ra")).unwrap(),
            b"let x = 1;"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn document_inspect_reports_none_when_closed() {

        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::InspectDocument,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("document: none".to_owned())

    }

    #[test]
    fn document_duplicate_open_is_rejected() {
        let (dir, service) = document_service();
        let source = write_device_file(dir.path(), "main.ra", "let x = 1;");
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::OpenDocument {
                    source: source.clone()
                },
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Opened("opened main.ra".to_owned())
        );
        // Opening an already-open document is rejected by the lifecycle.
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::OpenDocument { source },
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn document_close_without_open_is_rejected() {
        let (_dir, service) = document_service();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::CloseDocument,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn document_save_persists_the_current_content() {
        let (dir, service) = document_service();
        let source = write_device_file(dir.path(), "main.ra", "let x = 1;");
        invoke(
            &service,
            BackboneMessageKind::Request,
            ServiceOperation::OpenDocument { source },
            HubId::WORKSPACE,
        );
        // Modify the current state, then save: the persisted content is the
        // modified content — save is real, not a re-write of the loaded
        // bytes.
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::SetDocumentContent("let y = 2;".to_owned()),
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::SaveDocument,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Completed
        );
        assert_eq!(
            std::fs::read(stored_document(dir.path(), "main.ra")).unwrap(),
            b"let y = 2;"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,
                BackboneMessageKind::Request,
                ServiceOperation::InspectDocument,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Inspected("document: main.ra: let y = 2;".to_owned())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn document_save_without_open_is_rejected() {
        let (_dir, service) = document_service();
        assert_eq!(
            invoke(
                &service,

                ServiceOperation::SaveDocument,
                HubId::WORKSPACE
            ),
            ServiceResult::Rejected
        );
    }
